findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
1) Vertical trim piece observed missing on the corner near the meat room chicken station handsink.
2) Wall in the meat room walk-in cooler observed to be damaged near the swinging doors to the meat room. 
Repair and maintain physical facilities in good condition.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text:
5-205.15 Hot water would not shut off at the meat department 3 part sink by use of the hot water handle. The lever that switched between free flowing water from the faucet and use of the sprayer allowed for shut off, but hot water will still run constantly and potentially impact the cold water when used. Provide proper repairs so both the hot and cold water shut off via the faucet handles. 
A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. A work order will be placed for the abovementioned plumbing issue to be repaired.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 One of the handsinks in the meat room was blocked by carts full of portioned products. All crew members present at the time of inspection were advised that handsinks are to be accessible at all times and to cease the practice of placing equipment of any kind in front of handinks. Carts were moved to allow for access to the handsink in question. 
Handwashing sinks are to be accessible at all times and used only for handwashing. Cease the practice of blocking handsinks with equipment.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Quat solution in the 3 part sink in the meat room was observed at a concentration below 100ppm and appeared to be freshly prepared. Solution was discarded. New solution was dispensed and observed at 200-400ppm. Ensure test strips are used to verify proper concentration of quat solutions.
A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Maintain quat solution at 150-400ppm per label directions.

findings.title: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use
findings.citation_text:
2-401.11. Employee was observed chewing gum while working in the meat room. Employee discarded gum upon request of inspector. 

Employees shall eat (including gum/candy), drink, or use any form of tobacco only in designated areas where the contamination of exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; unwrapped single service and single use articles; or other items needing protection can not result.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 One handsink in the meat room was blocked by a roll cart and hose caddy. Items were moved to allow access to the handsink. Proper use and access of handsinks were discussed. 

Handwashing sinks are to be accessible at all times and used only for handwashing. Do not block access to handsinks with carts and other items.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11 Cartons of raw shell eggs were observed above milk in the retail cooler. Items were rearranged to allow for proper storage so that raw eggs were not directly above milk.

Food shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display by separating raw animal foods from ready to eat foods.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text:
5-205.15 First section of handwashing sinks in the men's room had low water pressure at the third faucet. The second faucet in the same section of sinks had slightly more pressure, and the first faucet had adequate water pressure. 

Handwashing sink by the 3 part sink in the meat room was observed to have a significant amount of water leaking out the back when sink was in use. A pipe was observed to be loose. Once the pipe was repositioned, a leak was still present allowing for water accumulation on the floor in the surrounding area. 

A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. A work order will be placed for the abovementioned plumbing issues to be repaired.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Some grease has leaked onto the floor at the used grease bin. 750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Wall in back behind grease bin has hole where pressed board is broken. 750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings. Repair wall.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.citation_text: 750.160 - Ice scoop (produce area) had no handle (broke off). Use scoops with handles for dispensing foods including ice (measuring cup, pitcher, etc. no glass - use plastic or metal). Scoop was discarded in trash. **Store scoops w/ handle extended up out of ice or in a holder outside of the ice machine**

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text: 750.1060 - Produce prep area has only hot water (at 3 compartment sink & handsink). Hot & cold water are available in other areas of the store. Get sinks in produce area repaired so both hot & cold water are available.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floor under pallets in bakery walkin freezer was soiled (smaller freezer). Clean the floor under the pallets in the freezer. Clean the floors under shelves & equipment daily/as needed.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - A few ceiling tiles were missing from bakery area. Workers are on site doing repairs on the roof. Make sure tiles are put back in place in between times when workers need access in order to protect food & equipment from dust, etc. that may fall out of th areas when tiles are not in place.
